title: Bugfix extxyz constraints from first frame
body:
Closes #1849. !3812 should be merged first. (EDIT: YI) Closes #765 as well

Questions:
- I've added a test for .extxyz writing. Should this test be applied to all formats?
- Is there a reason constraints were written from the first frame originally?

comments.author: yuzie007
comments.body:
Thank you so much @ThomasWarford for opening the MR! I could reproduce the issue in #1849 and confirmed that the present MR solves it.
Both the fix and the added test look excellent. I made just a revision based on !3812 on my side. I think we can merge very soon after confirming that all the other tests pass in the pipeline.

Regarding your questions:

> I've added a test for .extxyz writing. Should this test be applied to all formats?

I do not think so. The `move_mask` column is specifically for the extxyz format in ASE and not used in other formats.

> Is there a reason constraints were written from the first frame originally?

I do not think so again. The issue was referred to recently in https://gitlab.com/ase/ase/-/merge_requests/3795#note_2698769039 and also long years ago in #765.
I think we now mostly agree that this is a bug to be fixed, and your #1849 also clearly highlights it.
